name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Forearm Rotation
steps: Sit beside the bench and rest one forearm on it with your hand beyond the edge.
Hold the dumbbell off center with the longer end above your thumb and rotate your forearm until your palm angles down.
Turn the dumbbell upright and then outward until your palm angles up.
Return to the upright position and switch arms.
tips: Keep your elbow and shoulder still so all rotation occurs at the forearm.
Use a comfortable arc that lets you keep your wrist straight.
